name: hbm_hc_tail_child_k2-k2-COMMIT
purpose: H.STA.BLK.1 HC Sinkhorn tail child (hard child x2 in the HC root, TAILC=1), SKCE 1: the Sinkhorn on the core clock with a one-flop step ENABLE (ot_hdc_sinkhorn_ce) instead of the k1/k1b logic-derived /7 sclk (k1/k1b --cts gates FAILED: CTS-0040 left the 3,088-sink sclk net untreed on one INVx1). Source = gate-level CLONED netlist (per-module ABC map, bound_fanout_clone --limit 24 --tag sk_=Sinkhorn, retained re-synth, compact_netlist.py). Primary: square 358.56 x 358.56 (util ~0.5), mixes W / bases+scales+launch N / result E (<=2.5 pins/um), clk+rst_n S. | SAFE checklist (HBM-HCROOT8 10-20): 1 pins PASS (RTL pin flops + 2nd stage on every data pin; rst_n reset_landing 2 then ot_rst_relay 3 regions + kept leaf) | 2 reach: side <= 441 um, every pin->core hop registered; post-GRT 405 by gate | 3 fanout PASS: clone limit 24, native32 census (README) | 4 depth: released fp32/Sinkhorn units; the Sinkhorn step (one normalisation, ~5.4 ns) is the DECLARED multicycle 7 between its own registers (tailc_skmcp.sdc, priced since 10-15 in L = 198 + SDIV + CAP + 2); every other path single-period | 5 storage: no runtime-indexed flop array > 2 kb | 6 floorplan: no macros, util ~0.5 of synthesis area, full std-cell band | 7 clock: ONE root (clk), no derived clock; spread <=80 by --cts gate; io_hold_margin 0.03 | 8 schedule: static, result edges unchanged (+2 to the root, TAILC).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_hc_tail_child_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/static_hc/native/ot_hbm_hc_tail_child_static_k2.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbm_hc_tail_child_k2/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbm_hc_tail_child_k2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hbm_hc_tail_child_k2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_hc_tail_child_static  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
